content:
I've been trying out quite a few new MagSafe wallets lately, looking for one that looks more like a traditional wallet. Vinich's MagSafe wallet is the latest one I've tried, offering over 15 color choices, looking like a traditional bifold wallet, designed to attach to the back of a leather iPhone, not clashing with the case, looking more like an extension of your iPhone case.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers brings you a look at the latest products in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you make the most of your wireless charging-enabled Apple devices.

Color Options

The manufacturer clearly wanted to go all-out with the colors, offering black, green, brown, and even purple options, all with a vintage worn-in feel that complements rather than competes with a leather case. In addition, there are many other colors available. Vinich also makes a Desert Titanium color, which is perfect if you're going case-free and using your phone naked.

Wallet Storage

Vinich lists three card slots and says you can actually fit three to five cards depending on thickness. For everyday use, you'd probably carry a driver's license, one or two cards, and a company access card. There's also room behind the cards to fold one or two bills, which is a feature I really love in small wallets like this — I try to keep about $20 in cash on me.

The card slots use an RFID-blocking material inside, while the interior is lined with microfiber so your cards don't constantly rub against the fabric. The magnet is strong enough — though I've used stronger ones, I've also used ones that were much weaker.

Three Things to Know Before Buying

First, this is synthetic leather, not genuine leather. It has scratch-resistant construction and reinforced stitching, which is expected at this price point, but if you want to match it with a genuine leather case, be aware the two materials won't be exactly the same. Vinich recommends treating it every three to six months.

Second, when shooting with the wide-angle or macro lens, it can gradually creep into frame. On most iPhones, the wallet hangs below the camera, but if you're shooting close-up, it's best to take it off to make sure it's not covering the lens at all.

Third, it doesn't function as a stand, even though it might look like it could. The cover is intentionally designed to be relatively soft so the magnetic ring isn't stressed, so if you're looking for a wallet that can prop up your iPhone for calls or video, this one isn't for you.

Conclusion

At under $25, if you've been using a nice leather case but couldn't find a wallet to match, the color options alone make it worth a look. Most MagSafe wallets aim to be 'invisible,' but this one is designed to complement other accessories, looking and feeling more like a traditional wallet you'd take out and use on its own. It would be even better if Find My tracking could be added in the future.

You can buy the Vinich MagSafe wallet on Amazon or directly from the Vinich website.
